entries.supportedStatement: The Compass explicitly states that no single room contains the whole and frames distinct forms of knowledge as remaining themselves while contributing to a larger landscape.
The Manor registry explicitly owns route truth, separates builder paths from visitor room identity, groups routes by value category, and distinguishes main-menu routes from Mirrorland doors.
The Laws surface declares Flow, Integrity, Reality, Structure and Test as the FIRST authorities, with Research separate as an examination-and-support layer and universal law unproven.
Research explicitly supplies evidence, methods, applied context, negative and mixed findings, claim ceilings and complete records without becoming a seventh FIRST authority.
The current Methods and Models showroom already uses X for models, Y for interpretive lenses and Z for model families while explicitly denying scientific validation and universal-law proof.

Gate 0 freezes IMI as instrument, UCIC as invariant candidate, separates methods/models/evidence/execution/custody/interface, rejects the global product, preserves prospective result NONE and outcome access PROHIBITED.

The current main registers the authorized H-Earth terrain and estate construction candidate path scope through four registry/tooling paths while preserving separate terrain, estate, manor, preview, deployment, release and publication authority boundaries.

Five frozen true UCIC route maps discriminated five external CSB official-record cases from fifteen plausible decoys, with median route hit rate 1.0, median causal coverage 1.0 and median true-minus-decoy advantage 0.8333333333333334.
Multiple current artifacts are consistent with coherence being used as a construction constraint across identity, routing and authority boundaries.
Earlier estate choices may be interpreted through the later constitutional coherence framework when contemporaneous evidence is incomplete.
The estate already contains bounded 3D/spatial precedents, but the synchronized constitutional Methods-Models successor has not yet been constructed or accepted.
